summary: Verified CSS contrast fix for checkout dropdowns. Auto-Reorder interval <select> now renders WHITE text (rgb(255,255,255)) on DARK background (rgb(10,25,41) - bg-bots-surface). Its options all carry className 'bg-bots-dark text-white'. Selecting 60/90 days updates the value correctly (functional regression passed). Shipping-state (line 1286) and billing-state (line 1998) options confirmed via source to have the 'bg-bots-dark text-white' contrast class matching the working shipping-state reference.
critical_code_review_comments: CheckoutPage.jsx is 2502 lines — recommend splitting into per-step components (CartStep, ShippingStep, PaymentStep, ReviewStep) for maintainability.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auto-Reorder select in Cart step confirmed white-on-dark. Note: navigating away from /checkout and back seems to clear the cart, so reaching Shipping/Payment steps requires re-adding a product within same flow. Verification of shipping-state/billing-state at runtime was done via source inspection only (both use className='bg-bots-dark text-white' on options).
